articles.summary: Hong Kong, October 30, 2026 – Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (“Futu”) today announced a collaboration with ARK Invest, a globally recognized investment management firm, to bring ARK Invest's innovative investment strategies to eligible professional investors in Hong Kong. The collaboration will broaden investors' access to global innovation opportunities, helping them position ahead of emerging technological trends and capture opportunities in the next wave of innovation.
articles.title: Futu Collaborates with ARK Invest to Bring Innovative Investment Strategies to Hong Kong
